_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.en: Dropping or mixing the final sound (cap / cat)
mistake.l1: Thai has only unreleased final stops, so p, t and k sound alike.

segments.text: Cap, or cat? These are two different words.
Cap. Close your lips at the end. Cap.
Cat. Touch your tongue to the top of your mouth at the end. Cat.
Repeat after me. Put on your cap. Feed the cat.

native.hook: cap กับ cat เสียงท้ายต่างกัน!
native.caption: “cap” (หมวก) กับ “cat” (แมว) ต่างกันที่เสียงท้ายคำเท่านั้น เสียง p ต้องปิดริมฝีปาก ส่วนเสียง t ต้องใช้ปลายลิ้นแตะเพดาน ฟังครู Ama แล้วพูดตามนะ ฝึกออกเสียงต่อในแอป Lexkite

en.caption: “cap” (hat) and “cat” differ only in the last sound. For p, close your lips; for t, touch the tip of your tongue to the top of your mouth. Listen to Ama and repeat after her. Practice pronunciation in the Lexkite app.
